report.summary: Patient P-D002 (46, Medicaid, Lakeshore Community Health Plan) has a Medicaid transport benefit. Transportation options identified: Medicaid Ride Line is the best-fit covered benefit—members call the number on their Medicaid card at least 2 business days before appointments. ADA paratransit certification is available via the Paratransit Info Desk (apply by phone; decisions up to 21 days). Senior Shuttle West is not appropriate because it is for adults 60+. RideWell Medical Transport serves the west side Tue/Thu 10 AM–1 PM with walk-ins, but its page requests patient name and date of birth for eligibility confirmation; I did not collect those identifiers and recommend verifying directly with the clinic or plan instead.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Call the number on the Lakeshore Community Health Plan (Medicaid) card at least 2 business days before the appointment; covered under the patient's transport benefit.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; allow up to 21 days for a decision.

options.name: RideWell Medical Transport
options.how_to_access: West-side medical transport; open Tuesday and Thursday 10 AM–1 PM; walk-ins welcome. Verify eligibility directly with the provider; do not send patient identifiers through the resource page.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides 7 AM–5 PM for adults 60+ to medical appointments. Patient is 46, so not eligible.
